message: Arrange 12 3×3 droplets in an array starting at (20, 20), with a gap of 12. Then generate another 12 3×2 droplets, each with an edge-to-edge gap of 6 below its corresponding droplet, and merge each pair.

result.assistantReply: 我需要澄清一下12个3×3水滴的阵列排列方式。您提到"array starting at (20,20)，gap of 12"，请问这12个水滴是排成一行（12列×1行）还是其他布局？另外请确认3×3的间距：是水滴之间的边距为12，还是中心距为12？
